title: Reprint · Last Bell, 2001
logline: The papers run the June 2001 Last Bell re-inked: the sidewalk, the bell, Gully's flatbed and the honk, 'You're not in there anymore.' 'I know.' The 2010 hand makes the honk a cleaner shape and the sidewalk longer. The book runs it beside the original.

margin.note: A second, smaller date under the gull: 2001.

panels.composition: The school from across the road, 3:05, the bell shape — drawn in 2010, the shape cleaner. WOOD and BARNABY on the far sidewalk, the sidewalk longer than in 2001.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a young man and a small dog on a long sidewalk across from a small-town high school with a clean jagged sound shape at its door, gray wash, no words
image.notes: A reprint: the script of dw_2001-06-01 in the 2010 hand.

panels.composition: The doors open; students pour toward the beach road.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, students pouring out of a school toward a beach road, gray wash

panels.composition: The flatbed passing, GULLY's arm out, the honk a clean shape.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a flatbed truck passing with a young man's arm out the window and a clean honk shape

panels.composition: WOOD watching the truck go, the dog looking up.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a young man watching a truck leave with a small dog looking up at him, gray wash

notes: Reprint pair, Last Bell 2001. The sidewalk longer in 2010.
